newsitem.title: JAPAN: ADNOC '97 naphtha premium set at $11.50 - traders.
newsitem.headline: ADNOC '97 naphtha premium set at $11.50 - traders.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co (ADNOC) has set the term naphtha price for its East Asian customers at about $11.50 over the mean of Middle Eastern quotes for a one-year term starting in January, traders said on Monday.
The new price compares to a $6.80 premium set for a one-year term period that began in July.
Two South Korean firms and a Japanese trading house are expected to lift about 500,000 tonnes of ADNOC cargoes under the new contracts, they said.
Bullish naphtha sentiment in the Asian market helped the supplier raise the term price substantially, they added.
